name: Stick

copy.title: STICK
copy.description: A simple three-level stretch of the underneath defender.

_interpretation: Trips to the right. 'Outside receiver' = Z (#1), 'inside receiver' = H (#2), 'third receiver' = Y (#3). X and RB are unassigned in the handoff and are left idle.

ball._provisional: Presentation-only throw target chosen by the renderer; the handoff did not specify one.
